title: Product of geometrically irreducible schemes over a field is irreducible
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $U$ and $V$ be schemes over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] that are geometrically irreducible over $K$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then the fibre product $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].
